# ZorbaTech

> ZorbaTech is a website and app development business in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, founded by Manu B. It builds websites, mobile-friendly apps (progressive web apps, PWAs) and e-commerce stores for small businesses, with one-time pricing and no monthly fees. Support is available in English and Tamil.

## Key facts
- Business name: ZorbaTech (tagline: Digital Solutions for Small Business)
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India; serves clients across India
- Founder: Manu B. Marketing Manager: Dhanu B
- Contact: +91 86102 12131 (phone and WhatsApp), manu@zorbatech.in, dhanu@zorbatech.in
- Website: https://zorbatech.in/

## Services
- Business websites for shops, restaurants, clinics and salons, with WhatsApp enquiry, Google Maps and Google Business Profile setup
- Mobile-friendly business apps (PWAs): stock register and inventory, GST billing, customer credit ledger (khata), appointment booking, staff attendance and salary
- E-commerce stores with product catalogue, cart, online payment and cash on delivery
- Pricing: written quote with a fixed one-time price, 3 months free maintenance, client owns their data

## Projects
- ZorbaKart (https://zorbakart.in/): online store for home, kitchen and lifestyle products, built and run by ZorbaTech
- Live demos of websites and apps: https://zorbatech.in/#demos

- A written quote with one fixed, one-time price for each project; 3 months free maintenance; no monthly fees
